candidates.statement: Inventory deployment 3.3.9 carries an invalid configuration (cfg-103, configuration_valid=false), producing configuration_value_rejected errors (6 occurrences, status 503) and 7 configuration rejections, driving inventory checkout errors and elevated error rate (0.05) that surface as gateway call-inventory ERROR spans.
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment record alone does not establish causation; no direct log line ties the rejected config value to the failing checkout span.

report.explanation: Inventory shows an invalid configuration revision (cfg-103) with configuration_value_rejected errors and 503s, matching the checkout error-rate alert and gateway ERROR spans calling inventory. Gateway metrics and logs are healthy, and no db-pool, redis-timeout, or memory-leak signals appear, so bad-configuration is the single bounded candidate.
